fileList.emptyDescription: Add video files and AI will automatically recognize speech and generate subtitles
fileList.formatSupport: Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV and more

fileItem.multiSpeakerHint: Detect and label speakers for this file (slower)
fileItem.errorUnknown: This file failed, but no error message was recorded.
fileItem.translateHint: Also write a translated copy for this file; the target language and model are set once in Settings
fileItem.translateDegradedHint: {{kept}} of {{total}} cues kept their original text, because the translation model did not return a usable answer for them. The rest of the file is translated; re-running the file translates it again from scratch.
fileItem.translateSkippedHint: No translated file was written. The source was detected as {{language}}, which is already the target language, so a copy would only duplicate the original. Change the target language in Settings ▸ Translation.

bottomBar.translateHint: Turn translation on or off for every pending file

processing.title: Processing
processing.skipExistingDesc: If a subtitle file for this video is already in the output folder, skip it
processing.concurrencyDesc: How many files are processed at once. All stages share one GPU, so more files at once does not necessarily mean more done per hour.

about.title: About
about.hint: Click "Check for Updates" to fetch the latest release from GitHub.

translate.title: Translation
translate.enableDesc: Newly queued files start with translation on; each file still has its own switch in the queue
translate.modelHint: The translation is written next to the original as <name>.<language>.srt; the original file is never overwritten.
translate.noModels: No translation model is available in this build.

system.title: System
system.logDirHint: Logs are kept for the last 7 days. Attach the newest file when reporting a problem.
system.configFileHint: Config and models are separate: this file holds settings only; models live where “Storage location” points.
system.cliHint: MonoSub will offer a command-line entry point that shares the same pipeline and the same models as the app. It is not available yet.
system.cliInstallHint: Once installed, use it directly in a terminal:

models.title: Models
models.description: MonoSub runs entirely on your machine. Download the speech model once and it stays available offline.

credits.title: Credits & Licenses
credits.sensevoice: Model: SenseVoice-Small (FunAudioLLM/SenseVoiceSmall) under the FunASR Model License v1.1.

models.storageLocationHint: Models are read from and downloaded into this folder. Existing files are not moved.
models.pathFromEnv: Set by the MONOSUB_MODELS_DIR environment variable.
models.pathEnvOverrides: MONOSUB_MODELS_DIR is set, so it overrides this setting.
models.rescanHint: Re-read install state from disk (use after copying models in by hand)
models.supportedHint: Run end to end here and known to work
models.unverifiedHint: Not yet run end to end; it may not work
models.unsupportedHint: This version of MonoSub does not offer this model. It is listed for completeness; the planner never selects it and it cannot be downloaded.

modes.streamingHint: Audio is fed in chunks with state carried across them: lower peak memory, and speaker labels stay consistent because the session is never restarted.

errors.modelNotInstalled: The speech model is not installed. Click this file's error badge to see details and download it.

modelPlan.notConfigured: No recognition plan has been saved yet. Open Settings → Models, answer the four questions, and try again.
modelPlan.unreadable: The saved recognition plan cannot be read. Open Settings → Models and save the plan again.
modelPlan.unsupportedModel: The saved plan uses a model this version no longer supports. Open Settings → Models and save the plan again.

errors.translationModelNotInstalled: The translation model is not installed. Click this file's error badge to see details and download it.
errors.engineMissing: The speech engine is missing or not executable. Reinstall MonoSub to restore it.
errors.engineFailed: Speech recognition failed. See the logs for details.
errors.audioExtractFailed: Could not extract audio from this file.

missingModel.unknown: MonoSub cannot tell which model is missing. Open Settings → Models to check what is installed.
missingModel.needsDownload: This model has to be downloaded before the file can be transcribed.
missingModel.installed: Downloaded. The file can be transcribed now.

errors.detailsHint: Copy the message into a bug report, or open the log directory for what led up to it.
errors.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard. Select the text and copy it manually.
errors.logsFailed: Could not open the log folder.

modelPlan.title: Recognition plan
modelPlan.languageProfileHint: What the audio actually contains. Pick “English-led” for English recordings, and “Chinese + English” when a single sentence can switch between the two — a Chinese-only model would drop half of it.
modelPlan.diarizationDefaultHint: Default for newly added files; each file can override it
modelPlan.wordTimestampsHint: Derive subtitle timing from word timings instead of estimating it per chunk, and write a <name>.words.json sidecar with silences for automatic video editing. Needs the Qwen3 Forced Aligner model.
modelPlan.memoryBudgetHint: How much memory the model may occupy — which also decides its speed, because the fastest model here is the smallest. “Small” is the ~250 MB class.
modelPlan.gapTitle: No model plan can satisfy the current requirements
modelPlan.reasonWords: The only option with word-level timestamps
modelPlan.slotVadHint: Splits the audio into speech segments before transcription. Silero VAD ships with the app, so this is rarely changed.
modelPlan.slotAsrHint: Turns each speech segment into text. This is the model that decides recognition accuracy and language support.
modelPlan.slotDiarHint: Detects who spoke when, so cues can be labelled Speaker A/B. Needs a diarization model; without it the transcript has no speaker labels.

urlImport.title: Import from a link
urlImport.hint: One link per line, or separated by spaces. Bilibili videos only for now.
urlImport.autoStartHint: When a video has no platform subtitle, download its audio and start right away

login.explain: Bilibili needs a login to hand out this subtitle. Pick the browser you are signed in with, then retry.
login.privacy: MonoSub reads only bilibili.com cookies from the browser you pick, and only for the request on this machine.
login.safariHint: Safari also needs Full Disk Access for MonoSub in System Settings → Privacy & Security. Chrome and Edge will ask for your keychain.
login.queuedHint: Bilibili only offers this video's subtitle to signed-in users. Settings → URL Import can add your cookies to skip recognition next time.

errors.unsupported_kind: This page type is not supported
errors.needsCookies: Bilibili requires a login for this video
errors.multiPart: This is a multi-part video. Paste the link of the part you want.
errors.rateLimited: Bilibili is rate-limiting requests, please try again later
errors.engineMissing: The downloader (yt-dlp) is missing. Reinstall MonoSub.
errors.subtitleUnusable: This video's subtitle could not be read
errors.outputDirFailed: Could not create the output folder
errors.writeFailed: Could not write the subtitle file
errors.cacheDirFailed: Could not create the cache folder
errors.infoJsonFailed: Could not prepare the subtitle download

settings.title: URL import
settings.outputDirHint: Downloaded video/audio and the subtitle go into this same folder, named after the video. Leave empty for ~/Downloads/MonoSub.
settings.cookiesBrowserHint: Needed only for videos whose subtitles require a login.
settings.preferLocalHint: Ignore platform subtitles and always run speech recognition, so the result matches a local file.
settings.privacy: Reading cookies only happens when you pick a browser. Only bilibili.com cookies are read, and only on this machine.
settings.clipboardWatchHint: Offer a one-click import when you copy a Bilibili video link
